name: gharoo-care
description: Gharoo Care - Full Stack Repair Service Application

scripts.start:clients: npm run build && npm run dev:clients
scripts.build: npm run build:user && npm run build:admin && npm run build:service-man
scripts.build:user: npm install --prefix Gharoo/Gharoo_client && npm run build --prefix Gharoo/Gharoo_client
scripts.build:admin: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.build:service-man: npm install --prefix service-man-client && npm run build --prefix service-man-client
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:service" "npm run dev:server"
